title: imify datasets list result
description: Written to stdout by `imify datasets list --json`: the datasets that match the filters, in the requested order.

id.description: Dataset id assigned by the API, a UUID string.

task.description: Task description the episodes were recorded for.

embodiment.description: Display label of the robot embodiment, such as `so100`.

cameras.description: Camera names recorded in the episodes.

created_at.description: Creation time as sent by the API, an ISO 8601 date-time.

episodes.description: Number of episodes in the dataset.

accepted.description: Number of episodes that passed quality control.
